welcome.title: Organize your soccer matches professionally
welcome.subtitle: Confirm RSVPs automatically, draw balanced teams fairly, schedule match times, vote for the best player, and keep everyone updated on WhatsApp!

roster.title: Easy RSVP & Attendance List
roster.description: Confirm who is playing with one tap. The roster and waitlist are automatically organized by football position so you know exactly who is in.

skills.title: Player Skill Cards
skills.description: Rate players from 0 to 5 on core skills like passing, shooting, and defending, and visualize them on an interactive radar graph.

bucket_shuffle.title: Fair & Balanced Teams
bucket_shuffle.description: No more stacked teams! Automatically draw teams balanced by player skill and position, ensuring goalkeepers are locked to each side.

ils_scheduling.title: Match Schedule Generator
ils_scheduling.description: Generate match fixture schedules instantly to keep the games flowing, balance match-ups, and minimize waiting time on the bench.

z_score_voting.title: Vote for the MVP
z_score_voting.description: Let players rate each other after the match to elect the craque (MVP) using a fair scoring model that neutralizes voting bias.

waha_whatsapp.title: WhatsApp Notifications
waha_whatsapp.description: Keep the group informed! Send attendance lists, balanced team sheets, and game scores straight to your WhatsApp group chat.

finances.title: Simple Dues & Payments
finances.description: Track monthly fees for regular players and pay-per-play costs for guests with a single click, keeping your group's budget clean.

features.title: Everything You Need for Match Day
features.subtitle: Smart scheduling, balanced teams, and integrations designed to give you a professional soccer group manager.

mock.no_fifo_bias: No FIFO bias: Sorted by Position (GK > DF > MF > ST) & Name.
mock.goalkeepers_fixed: Goalkeepers fixed to teams. Other positions shuffled & greedily balanced.
mock.ratings_normalized: Ratings normalized (1 to 10) to neutralize strict/lenient voter bias.
